sourceData.meaningMnemonic: The <radical>meet</radical> radical and the <kanji>meet</kanji> kanji are the same!
sourceData.readingMnemonic: What better way to <kanji>meet</kanji> new people than to start <reading>kay</reading>aking (<ja>かい</ja>)! Get into your kayak and just float out into the water. You'll eventually bump into someone else in a kayak and boom, you're meeting someone new!
sourceData.readingInfo: "I met my soulmate in a kayak," said Koichi.
